pages.text: Energy Conduits carry $(l)FE$() (power) from generators and batteries to the machines that use it. With them, a machine no longer has to touch its generator.

$(li)Conduits $(l)connect by themselves$() to other conduits and to any block that uses or stores FE, from CyberFarm or any other mod.$(br)$(li)All three tiers join into one network. A network can be up to $(l)1,024$() conduits long.
pages.title: Placing

pages.text: $(li)Machines built with $(l:basics/cyber_frame)Cyber Frames$(/l) (Bio-Digester, Biomass Press, Gas Turbine, Electrolyzer and the others) take a conduit on $(l)any of their frames$(), not only on the machine block. Pipes and hoppers too.
$(li)A generator pushes power only from its own block. If your conduit touches one of its frames instead, $(l)right-click the conduit's arm$() so it pulls (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)).
$(li)Conduits $(l)store nothing$(): what a generator pushes in goes straight to the machines on the network.$(br)$(li)The machines $(l)take turns$(), so none is left without power.
pages.title: How it works

pages.text: $(li)Most batteries don't push. To draw from one, $(l)right-click the arm$() of the conduit touching it so it pulls. A $(l:energy_storage/battery_bank)Battery Bank$(/l) side set to $(l)Out$() pushes by itself.$(br)$(li)The sleeves have $(l)cyan lights$(). While energy flows, a $(l)cyan arc$() runs through the glass.

The rate is how much FE can enter the network per tick from each generator or battery, set by the conduit that touches it.$(br)$(li)$(l)Energy Conduit$(): grey, 2,000 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Energy Conduit$(): gold, 16,000 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Energy Conduit$(): violet, 128,000 FE/t
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: A Medium Steam Turbine needs Advanced conduits at its ports, a Large one Elite conduits. To upgrade a line already in place, use the $(l:cables/cable_swapper)Cable Swapper$(/l).
